## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the limitation or workflow gap you are experiencing.
Example: *I find it difficult to ... when using RecallX with ...*

## Proposed Solution / Enhancement
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include API signatures, CLI command syntax, or MCP tool definitions if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Local-First and Privacy Considerations
Explain how this proposal aligns with RecallX's local-first, zero-telemetry, and offline-compatible design principles.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, references, or mock outputs about the feature request here.
